learning_objective: 🎯 Master the powerful smashes, lightning-fast footwork, and clever serves needed to absolutely rule the badminton court!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Holding the racket correctly is the first step to winning! You should hold it like you are gently shaking hands with someone. A relaxed grip lets you snap your wrist for powerful shots.
The serve is how every point begins. You can do a high serve to push your opponent to the back of the court, or a sneaky low serve to make them rush forward in panic!
Badminton footwork is like a fast dance. You must always return to the center of the court after every shot so you are ready to pounce in any direction.

fun_activity.title: 🏆 The Digroz Wall Volley
fun_activity.instructions: Grab your racket and a shuttlecock, stand a few feet away from a blank wall outside, and try to hit it continuously against the wall. Count your highest streak without letting it drop!

quick_recap: ⭐ The 'shake-hands' grip gives you maximum control and power over your shots.
⭐ A strong serve sets the tone for the entire rally.
⭐ Quick, light footwork is just as important as hitting the shuttlecock hard.
